description: Akasha Solo is a one-person team: Pang Qin Chan, competing online in NASA Space Apps 2026. Akasha is Sanskrit for aether, the open sky, which gave our project its name, AetherRidge. I did the problem framing, the data pipeline on NASA LOLA, Horizons and PGDA data, the web app, validation, and the demo video with my own narration. An AI assistant (Claude) helped write the code; I made the decisions and checked every number. Goal: make south pole landing trade-offs clear to anyone in seconds.
